en: The postcard features four black-and-white photographic views of a small rural village. The upper-left photo shows swans on a river marked 'An der Emmer.' The upper-right image features a traditional half-timbered building labeled 'Gasthaus Heinr. Brückmann.' The two lower images show quiet village streets with similar old houses and countryside scenery. The text 'THAL b. BAD PYRMONT' is prominently displayed in the center. The reverse side has a stamp of the 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT' and printed information from a publisher in Kiel.
